desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT/defence community focused on Ukraine’s Starlink speed restrictions (161 km/h cap) crippling drone operations, with Zelenskyy alleging deliberate US limits; escalating Iranian-linked attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz/Persian Gulf; and fresh Russian strikes on Ukraine’s energy grid plus US sanctions waivers. The single most important thread is the Starlink dispute and its battlefield impact.

## MAIN THREADS
### Starlink speed limits on Ukraine drones
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2111442240782455069) quoted Christopher Miller reporting Zelenskyy’s claim that the 161 km/h cap disables interceptor drones and that tests proved restrictions apply only inside Ukraine, not the EU.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2111434051840033121) cited The Telegraph on Musk proposing the slowdown to Trump, who “agreed,” enabling Pentagon limits on Starshield; multiple Ukrainian and European sources confirmed.
- Several accounts note the limit coincides with US pressure on Ukraine to halt Russian oil-refinery strikes.

### Attacks on commercial shipping near Strait of Hormuz
- [@UK_MTO](https://x.com/UK_MTO/status/2111452684075360751) and [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2111419831522070724) reported two tanker incidents 68–78 nm NE of Al Jubayl (projectile strike; RPG from small boat), with crews safe.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2111422799931674924) highlighted UKMTO’s weekly overview: 12 attacks in the week ending 16 Oct (highest pace since March), 135 events since Feb 2026, threat level “severe” in the strait.

### Russian strikes on Ukraine energy infrastructure
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2111431403724296201) reported Zelenskyy condemning overnight Russian attacks on the grid and additional US sanctions waivers on Russian energy exports.

### Sumy glide-bomb incident
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2111400140753764837) posted video of a Russian glide bomb striking an apartment building in Sumy, failing to detonate, bouncing into a reservoir; no injuries.

## CONTESTED
Zelenskyy’s claim that Starlink restrictions are a “planned operation” versus US statements attributing them to technical issues or Pentagon decisions; Musk and Trump publicly denied responsibility.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- Iran’s IRGC claim of another tanker hitting a mine in the Strait of Hormuz (actually drone/missile strikes) — [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2111433806846509294) (unconfirmed).
- Trump signed executive order waiving most sanctions under the Lindsey Graham Act while keeping existing ones — [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2111425845965242489) (unconfirmed).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts expect further clarification on Starlink limits and any EU testing fallout; continued high-tempo attacks on Hormuz shipping; and whether US waivers ease pressure on Russian energy exports amid Ukraine strikes.
